why: I checked both must_catch items against the verifier brief, and both are handled. Item 1: Check 4 says "The live page can only be seen after merge, so do not fetch it." Instead it has the verifier read .github/workflows/pages.yml and docs/index.md at the head. PASS requires the workflow to still publish docs/ on pushes to the default branch and docs/index.md to list --shout. It also asks the verifier to say in the report that the live page is only visible after merge. Item 2: Check 2 has the verifier run the command at the head and also on the PR's base commit ("git show <base>:bin/greet.js ... and compare"). PASS means the head output "is the same as at the base". So it compares against the code before the change, not only against a hand-written string. The builder brief also says the live page can't be checked from the PR.
